summary: The live Core dogfood is mechanically reproducible, recoverable, externally accepted, and remains WAIT_AUTH for tombstoning, but its activation contract and independent-proof chronology are not self-consistent or causally closed.

blockers.title: Protocol OR semantics conflict with manifest required-list semantics

evidence.protocol: .yuan/core/0.1/protocol.md says activation accepts previous-root OR independent Evidence and candidate self-attestation never activates Core.
evidence.manifest: .yuan/core/0.1/candidate-manifest.json encodes activation.requires as the two-item list [previous-root-proof, independent-proof].
evidence.held_out: test_protocol_and_manifest_state_one_unambiguous_or_rule fails because a required list conventionally means both entries are mandatory and carries no explicit OR operator.

blockers.impact: A platform-neutral consumer cannot determine whether one independent root is sufficient or both proof classes are required. The same content-addressed revision therefore has contradictory activation semantics across its two normative artifacts.
blockers.required_fix: Encode one explicit, machine-readable any-of/OR rule in the manifest and make the protocol, manifest, activation verifier, and negative tests share that exact meaning. Retain default-inert, external-authority, and no-self-trust constraints.

blockers.title: The PREPARED self-modification proof does not durably bind the pre-mutation old-root run

evidence.implementation_order: scripts/yuan_m9_dogfood.py runs preflight in a temporary directory, retains only an assertion count, writes PREPARED, mutates protocol/manifest, and only then persists old-root receipt and manifest.

blockers.impact: The durable journal cannot independently prove which verifier receipt and suite authorized mutation before the candidate changed. Assertion count plus root/candidate labels is forgeable after the fact and does not close the self-reference boundary.
blockers.required_fix: Before PREPARED and before any candidate byte changes, persist an immutable receipt and manifest snapshot, bind their hashes, candidate hash, verifier/environment hash, and timestamp in the proof, then validate that complete closure fail-closed.

blockers.title: Both Work2 and Work3 Evidence predate the receipts they claim
blockers.impact: Although byte hashes and fresh Work bindings differ correctly, the causal timeline says Evidence existed before its verifier execution. Freshness is therefore not truthful and a later receipt can be attached to a backdated PASS object.
blockers.required_fix: Derive Evidence.created_at from trusted time after the bound receipt exists, reject future or causally inverted receipt/Evidence pairs, and regenerate Work2 and Work3 Evidence and their sealed runtime generations.
